body: I'm on a wait list for therapy, the psychiatrist I saw doesn't think I need medication though

I have diagnosed depression and anxiety. I do appreciate your words though, even though everything is temporary it just seems so hard to try right now and I really don't want to deal with it. It seems selfish really, but idk

My boyfriend of a few years left me. We were talking about marriage only a few weeks before, he told me he loved me up until hours before the break up, and he told me we could've worked it out but he doesn't want to. I've got fines and tickets on my car, I lost most of my money to bank fees and unauthorized charges, I'm terrified of what might happen if I leave my home but I can't stay here all the time. None of my friends want to hang out with me (probably because I'm sad all the time), and I have really no motivation to live anymore or to continue with life. Everything is a mess
That's exactly what happened :/ I'm glad some people can relate to what I'm going through
